decision_scope: SELECT_ONLY_THE_VALIDATION_STRATEGY_FOR_THE_FIRST_AUTHORED_L03_OPI; DO_NOT_VALIDATE_IT, ASSERT_TRANSLATION, CREATE_CANONICAL_OPI_IDS_OR_LABELS, UNLOCK_QA_OR_OTHER_OPI, CHANGE_STR003_STR005, GENERALIZE_KE, OR_ACTIVATE_RUNTIME

strategy_decisions.statement: Validate later only against exact preservation of VALI KE and PARAZAMI KE as the closed parallel source package.
Keep natural-language translation UNRESOLVED_NOT_ASSERTED during validation strategy selection.
Do not validate the OPI in this strategy gate.
Preserve selector 1 as NONCANONICAL_STRUCTURAL_INDEX_ONLY and create no canonical OPI ID or label.
If approved, open only a separate position-1 OPI validation-application gate and stop.

governance_decisions.statement: Validation-strategy approval is not OPI validation.
No subject/person, tense/aspect, copula or natural-language translation semantics are introduced or inferred.
No universal L03/HNK interrogative grammar or question-to-declarative derivation is created.
VALI FROZEN, PARAZAMI WATCH and KE CANDIDATE/non-generalized remain unchanged.
DARUNO/NELARA parent lexeme gate and HNK3000 remain untouched.
A future SIGA may approve only this position-1 OPI validation strategy while this gate remains active.
